open_points.subject: project-create replay after the created project changes
open_points.text: “a retried create never makes a second project while the first keeps its values” does not say which changes mean the first no longer “keeps its values,” or what a retry does after an ordinary correction; R0-36 specifies a new create after erasure or anonymisation but not after correction
open_points.question: After a project created without a supplied id is corrected and the original create request is retried, is it still the same replay, and what observable answer or failure must Registry produce?
options: Return the existing project in its current corrected state without creating another
Refuse the retry because the existing project no longer equals the originally created state
Treat the retry as a new create and mint a second project
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the retry without changing either project or creating another.

witness.initial: No project exists, and Registry has no prior record of the create request.
events: The owner creates a project without supplying an id; Registry creates project P at revision 1.
The owner corrects P, changing its object or name and moving it to revision 2.
The owner retries the original create request after having lost its first answer.
outcomes: Registry recognizes the replay and returns P, now at revision 2, without creating another project.
Registry considers that P no longer keeps its values and treats the request as a new create, minting project Q with the original values.
witness.observer: The owner and any consumer listing projects see whether one or two projects exist.
